title: Gerald the Construction Android
description: &6Gerald the Construction Android&r is the most powerful weapon in the mod. Using this has the side effect of setting the world on fire but also getting tektite, which contains &6Osmiridium&r.
Gerald is the hardest recipe of the mod requiring hundreds of thousands of items, mainly circuit related.

Vast quantities of &6Bismuth&r, &6Tantalum&r and &6Silicon&r are needed, so dont hold back on bedrock ore processing and parallelisation of many processes. If you havent already used &dAE2&r, it is highly recommended at this stage of the game.

Launching Gerald will result in a global firestorm that will decimate all life, including all trees and grass. Make sure to keep a backup of your world before launching him. Gerald can also be launched in the &eNether&r or &eEnd&r.
Alternatively, the modpack introduces a &3Chemical Plant&r recipe for &6Osmiridium Infused Tektite&r to avoid the performance issues with launching gerald.
&2A Plasma Forge with a plasma input energy of 25MTU/t is required.&r &2DHC or Stellar Flux plasma is needed.&r
&2Blueprints can be found in structures, purchased from Bobmazon or made in a Precision Assembler.
